title: rubus scaber var. macrostachys
intro: Rubus scaber var. macrostachys, commonly known as Korean bramble or wild raspberry, is a type of plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It has been traditionally used in East Asian medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus scaber var. macrostachys include analgesic, anti-histaminic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, allergies, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating activities.
